name: Conorfone
summary: Conorfone (INN; TR-5109), also known as conorphone and codorphone, as well as conorphone hydrochloride (USAN), is an opioid analgesic that was never marketed. It is an analogue of hydrocodone substituted with an 8-ethyl group and an N-cyclopropylmethyl group.

pharmacology.text: It acts as a mixed agonist-antagonist at the μ-opioid receptor, and is slightly more potent than codeine in analgesic effects, but associated with somewhat greater side effects.

uses.text: Conorfone (INN; TR-5109), also known as conorphone and codorphone, as well as conorphone hydrochloride (USAN), is an opioid analgesic that was never marketed.

sideEffects.en: In studies it caused somewhat more side effects than codeine. Opioids of its kind can cause drowsiness, dizziness, nausea and unease, and slowed breathing at high levels.
sideEffects.zh: 在研究中，它的副作用比可待因稍多。這類鴉片類藥物可能造成嗜睡、頭暈、噁心與不安，濃度高時可能抑制呼吸。
sideEffects.zhHans: 在研究中，它的副作用比可待因稍多。这类鸦片类药物可能造成嗜睡、头晕、恶心与不安，浓度高时可能抑制呼吸。

fact.en: Its cyclopropylmethyl group on the nitrogen is the same one that turns oxymorphone into the opioid blocker naltrexone, and it often gives an opioid mixed agonist-antagonist activity.
fact.zh: 它氮原子上的環丙基甲基，與把羥嗎啡酮變成鴉片類阻斷劑納曲酮的基團相同，而這個基團常讓鴉片類藥物具有混合型促效拮抗作用。
fact.zhHans: 它氮原子上的环丙基甲基，与把羟吗啡酮变成鸦片类阻断剂纳曲酮的基团相同，而这个基团常让鸦片类药物具有混合型促效拮抗作用。
